name: @kalamdb/orm
description: Drizzle ORM driver and schema generator for KalamDB
author: KalamDB Team

scripts.ensure:linked-client: node -e "const fs=require('fs');process.exit(fs.existsSync('node_modules/@kalamdb/client/dist/src/index.js')?0:1)" || (npm --prefix ../client install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ../client run build && npm install --no-package-lock --no-save ../client)
scripts.ensure:linked-consumer: node -e "const fs=require('fs');process.exit(fs.existsSync('node_modules/@kalamdb/client/dist/src/index.js')&&fs.existsSync('node_modules/@kalamdb/consumer/dist/src/index.js')?0:1)" || (npm --prefix ../consumer install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ../consumer run build && npm install --no-package-lock --no-save ../client ../consumer)
scripts.prebuild: npm run ensure:build-deps && npm run ensure:linked-client
scripts.pretest: npm run ensure:test-deps && npm run ensure:linked-consumer
